method: The immutable v1.7.0 tag was cut from the tested master revision. Source-level catalog, disclosure, provenance, and MCP tests were followed by the tag-driven release workflow, which built each distribution format from the tagged source, checked its embedded source identity, exercised installed runtime and synthetic behavior, and published checksummed artifacts and a versioned multi-architecture container image.

checks: glibc234 and glibc239 compatibility tarball builds
Ubuntu 22.04 and Ubuntu 24.04 tarball runtime checks
automatic installer selection on Ubuntu 22.04 and Ubuntu 24.04
installed tarball and installer synthetic smoke suites
versioned linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 container image

limitations: This validation uses synthetic and packaging gates; it does not repeat the biological paper benchmarks.

The v1.7.0 release intentionally ships the four-record provenance snapshot pinned before release; this release-validation record was published afterward and is not recursively embedded in that snapshot.
Runtime checks cover the declared Ubuntu compatibility targets and are not a guarantee for every Linux distribution or host configuration.
